introduction.p: Josh and Jonathan are co-owners of a pastry shop. Josh bakes pies and Jonathan bakes cakes. Josh is able to bake p pies each day he works and Jonathan is able to bake c cakes each day he works.
One month, Josh worked 16 days and Jonathan worked 18 days. That month they produced {16p+18c} baked goods in total.

statement.p: The next month, Josh worked 21 days and Jonathan worked 17 days. How many baked goods did they produce that month?
How many baked goods was that in total for those two months?
